ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to advanced statistical methods used in behavorial research, including a variety of advanced statistical techniques, situations in which each technique would be used, and assumptions made by each method. Also examines structuring analysis and interpretation of results. Includes techinques for predicting both continous and categorical outcomes, as well as methods for hierarchically nested data. Prerequisite: Statistics 1 and a firm understanding of basic regression is assumed.
